column1: # Format: context<TAB>source<TAB>translation Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t). @id =
# command-id keyed (tr_id). @plural = plural forms: one|other (English) or one|few|many (Russian).
# @msg = status/error message template (message, msg). Other context = disambiguation for tr_ctx.
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of MoneyKeep Launcher's English labels in neutral,
# international Russian, using terms Russian-speaking users of desktop software know.
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true). Left
# in English on purpose: product name "MoneyKeep Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite name
# "MoneyKeep Apps", app names (MoneyKeep, CalcKeep), "GitHub" , "Website". Shortcut keys keep
# their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Esc). Trailing "…" (U+2026) must be preserved.
